_readme: Golden mandates for recall regression. Each entry freezes a search Herb has run before, with companies we KNOW belong in the results (verified real, on-thesis). After changing sources/prompts, dispatch a benchmark run and check recall: scripts/benchmark.py --dispatch <key>, later --check <key>. Expected lists are floors, not ceilings — finding MORE is good, missing these is a regression.

causal-ai-europe.theme: Causal AI companies in Europe — causal reasoning, causal inference, causal machine learning for industry

datacenter-cooling-eu.theme: Companies providing solutions for data center cooling — liquid cooling, immersion cooling, heat reuse
